sar.narrative: Customer C11003, holder of card C11003-K2, is the subject of this report due to suspicious transaction activity indicative of structuring and potential fraud. Between 2016-11-20 04:08 and 2016-11-20 05:17, three online purchases totaling $1,399.95 were executed on card C11003-K2 using device profile 'iOS Device | iOS 11.1.2 | mobile safari generic | 2208x1242'. Specifically, these transactions included amounts of $400.06 (transaction 3472547 at 04:08), $499.95 (transaction 3472599 at 05:04), and $499.94 (transaction 3472608 at 05:17). This activity occurred within a 69-minute window, with every amount kept just under a $500 authorization threshold to evade standard controls. Furthermore, the $499.94 purchase significantly exceeded the card's 95th percentile of $261.99 and its median of $107.92. A case-memory model score of 0.651 and feature profiling strongly tied this activity to confirmed-fraud closed cases, including CC-3841, CC-4086, CC-3748, and CC-1316, where eight of the eight most similar cases were verified as fraud. In response to these findings, the bank automatically created an investigation case and escalated the matter to an analyst. Additionally, the bank executed an L1 action to block card C11003-K2 and prepared an L2 filing of this SAR report.
